items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Harry Dial as being in Ira Coffee's band ('And in that band was some good buddies, Norman Mason, and Harry Dial'), but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not respond with any personal interaction, memory, or confirmation of meeting him.

ctx.x: This was a fellow's band by the name of Ira Coffee. He's out of St. Louis. And in that band was some good buddies, Norman Mason, and Harry Dial.
Was Harry Dial from St. Louis?
